def candidate(grid, k):
    n = len(grid)
    visited = [[False] * n for _ in range(n)]
    min_path = []
    min_value = float('inf')

    def dfs(x, y, path, value):
        nonlocal min_path, min_value
        if len(path) == k:
            if value < min_value:
                min_path = path[:]
                min_value = value
            return
        if x < 0 or x >= n or y < 0 or y >= n or visited[x][y]:
            return
        visited[x][y] = True
        dfs(x + 1, y, path + [grid[x][y]], value + grid[x][y])
        dfs(x - 1, y, path + [grid[x][y]], value + grid[x][y])
        dfs(x, y + 1, path + [grid[x][y]], value + grid[x][y])
        dfs(x, y - 1, path + [grid[x][y]], value + grid[x][y])
        visited[x][y] = False

    for i in range(n):

            dfs(i, j, [], 0)
